text:
Alex: Quick async takeoff check — doing a short sync on the roadmap items we're trying to roll today. What I did / blockers / plan for today.
Maria: Thx Alex. quick note: I pushed updated spec for the route-fallback behavior to the docs repo. needs a quick review from eng-runtime. link: https://git/repo/specs/route-fallback.md
Dan: Reviewing now. main open Q is fallback TTL and metrics tagging. I left inline comments.
Sophie: FYI I hit a perf regression in the dedicated queue test yesterday (99p latency +200ms). digging into batching settings.
Alex: Noted Sophie — can you drop the failing test output here? if it's flaky we can gate the rollout.
Sophie: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] qps=120 batch_size=8 median=42ms p99=512ms
[2026-03-15T09:12:04Z] qps=125 batch_size=16 median=45ms p99=720ms
```
Looks like larger batches causing p99 spike when cold caches.
Maria: OK, that suggests we need to tweak `max_batch_size` per model profile or enable warm-prefix caching for the canary. I can prototype a config tweak this afternoon.
Dan: For spec review: my main comment is we should include explicit migration steps for customers pinning model versions — add entry under "rollout" -> "fallbacks".
Alex: Good. Can we prioritize the spec review + Sophie perf fix before canary? I don't want to start canary until those two are done.
Sophie: I'll try a quick rollback to `batch_size=8` for the canary config and re-run. If p99 stays <500ms we can proceed.
deploy-bot: Canary canary-redwood-v2 started (canary-id: c-9831). status: queued -> running :rocket:
Maria: sounds good. timeline: I'll aim to update spec by EOD PT and open a PR linking Dan's comments.
Dan: I'll check the PR and do a fast pass in the morning. if everything's green we can approve.
Alex: Blockers: none other than the perf regression + spec signoff. Owners: Sophie (perf), Maria (spec), Dan (review). I'll do final go/no-go after Sophie posts new numbers.
Sophie: new run: p99=480ms with `batch_size=8` and warm-prefix caching on. Looks stable for a few cycles.
Alex: :+1: Marking as go for canary rollout step 1. Maria, Dan — when the PR is merged I'll schedule a canary smoke window and post the ETA here.
Maria: will do. posting PR link once ready.
Dan: ack.
Alex: thanks team — quick and focused. will follow up with a brief checklist in the channel when canary is live.
